title: Verify: IntroScreen and StoryPanel unit tests
summary: Verify: IntroScreen and StoryPanel unit tests
description: Unit tests written from the requirement spec with storage and DOM faked via jsdom; no server or browser is started.
acceptance_criteria: Tests fail without the Act and pass with it

steps.action: Render IntroScreen and assert text 'You decide.' and 'Begin' click calls onBegin. Render StoryPanel with the 'intro' node from scene.dialogue, click the first choice button, assert onChoose called with 0; render with inventory [] and assert 'Empty', then with ['key'] assert 'key'.
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/story.test.tsx
